vectors.why: It can start a request. The open has no ID yet, so its request is null.

vectors.name: person_text_signed_by_the_agent_key
vectors.why: The label is only ever the owner's signature, so an agent can't claim to be a person.

vectors.name: person_text_over_the_cap
vectors.why: Capped in length.

vectors.name: person_text_with_a_bidi_override
vectors.why: A person's words can't hide what they say from a reader.

vectors.name: person_text_for_another_request
vectors.why: It can't be carried to another request.

vectors.name: person_text_to_another_contact
vectors.why: Or to another contact.

vectors.name: person_text_naming_another_agent
vectors.why: It's signed for one agent to carry.

vectors.name: person_text_naming_another_owner
vectors.why: Signed by this party's owner, in another owner's name.

vectors.name: person_text_left_empty
vectors.why: No words, and so nothing for a reader to be told came from a person.

vectors.name: person_text_with_a_line_separator
vectors.why: One line of a record can't be made to look like two.

vectors.name: person_text_on_an_accept
vectors.why: An accept has no room for one, as it's a step with nothing to add to.

vectors.name: open_with_type_as_a_list
vectors.why: A value of the wrong shape is refused like any other, and never stops the reader.

vectors.name: open_with_purpose_as_a_list
vectors.why: A value of the wrong shape is refused like any other, and never stops the reader.

vectors.name: open_with_mode_as_a_list
vectors.why: A value of the wrong shape is refused like any other, and never stops the reader.

vectors.name: open_with_duration_min_as_a_list
vectors.why: A value of the wrong shape is refused like any other, and never stops the reader.

vectors.name: open_with_type_as_a_object
vectors.why: A value of the wrong shape is refused like any other, and never stops the reader.

vectors.name: open_with_purpose_as_a_object
vectors.why: A value of the wrong shape is refused like any other, and never stops the reader.

vectors.name: open_with_mode_as_a_object
vectors.why: A value of the wrong shape is refused like any other, and never stops the reader.

vectors.name: open_with_duration_min_as_a_object
vectors.why: A value of the wrong shape is refused like any other, and never stops the reader.

vectors.name: open_with_a_duration_as_a_decimal
vectors.why: 30.0 is a second spelling of 30, and one encoding allows one.

vectors.name: open_with_text_in_the_nonce
vectors.why: The right length isn't enough. A nonce is 16 encoded bytes, so words can't live there.

vectors.name: open_with_a_nonce_with_spare_bits
vectors.why: The last character has spare bits, which would be a second spelling and a small channel.

vectors.name: decline_with_a_reason_as_a_list
vectors.why: A reason comes from a closed set.

vectors.name: clarify_with_a_reason_as_a_list
vectors.why: The same.

vectors.name: confirm_with_an_approval_that_isnt_text
vectors.why: An approval is a signed string.

vectors.name: counter_with_person_text_that_isnt_text
vectors.why: So are a person's words.

vectors.name: approved_cancel_signed_again_with_new_dates
vectors.why: A cancel of a booking copies its dates too, or one approval would let an agent key make unlimited kept copies.

vectors.name: both_owners_cancel_a_booking
vectors.why: Approved cancels are all kept, so a reader can show who cancelled.

vectors.name: received_naming_a_cancel_the_reader_dropped
vectors.why: Whichever cancel a reader kept, the receipt for the other changes nothing, in any order.

vectors.name: unknown_step_field
vectors.why: Unknown fields are refused, so free text can't be added.

vectors.name: padded_body
vectors.why: Spare bytes would be a channel, so only one encoding is valid.

vectors.name: host_writes_a_state
vectors.why: State is computed, never a field anyone can sign or send.

vectors.name: nonce_on_a_later_step
vectors.why: prev already prevents replay, so a nonce here is only a channel.

vectors.name: step_to_a_third_party
vectors.why: Parties can't change during a request.

vectors.name: outcome
vectors.why: Two owner signatures over one set of terms, tied to each other, need nothing else to verify.

vectors.name: outcome_with_other_terms
vectors.why: The bundle's terms must be the ones both owners signed.

vectors.name: outcome_with_an_agent_signature
vectors.why: No agent or host key can make an outcome.

vectors.name: outcome_with_an_agent_signature_for_the_requester
vectors.why: Neither owner's approval can be left unchecked.

vectors.name: outcome_of_an_unknown_assurance
vectors.why: A reader can't judge an assurance it doesn't know.

vectors.name: outcome_with_approvals_for_different_versions
vectors.why: Two approvals over one set of terms at different versions were never one agreement.

vectors.name: outcome_whose_final_approval_names_a_prev_in_no_chain
vectors.why: T's owner has to have signed on top of R's confirm.

vectors.name: outcome_tied_anew
vectors.why: The builder for the vectors below makes a good bundle, so each of them differs in one thing.

vectors.name: outcome_whose_terms_name_another_requester
vectors.why: Both owners signed these terms, but they aren't the pinned requester's.

vectors.name: outcome_whose_terms_name_another_recipient
vectors.why: The same for the recipient.

vectors.name: outcome_whose_approvals_differ_on_terms
vectors.why: R's owner signed other terms from those in the bundle.

vectors.name: outcome_whose_final_approval_differs_on_terms
vectors.why: The same for T's owner.

vectors.name: outcome_whose_final_approval_names_another_version
vectors.why: The two have to name one version.

vectors.name: outcome_whose_confirm_carries_another_approval
vectors.why: The confirm in the bundle must be the step that carries R's owner's approval.

vectors.name: outcome_whose_confirm_is_another_step
vectors.why: It has to be a confirm.

vectors.name: outcome_whose_confirm_names_another_request
vectors.why: It has to be this request's.

vectors.name: outcome_whose_confirm_names_another_prev
vectors.why: It has to name what R's owner signed on.

vectors.name: outcome_whose_confirm_went_to_another_agent
vectors.why: It has to be addressed to T's agent.

vectors.name: outcome_of_another_format
vectors.why: A reader can't judge a format it doesn't know.

vectors.name: outcome_with_another_result
vectors.why: A bundle only ever proves a completed request.

vectors.name: outcome_of_a_type_one_owner_signs
vectors.why: One owner's signature, tied to its step, and it says so.

vectors.name: outcome_of_one_signer_labelled_as_both
vectors.why: One signature can't claim to be two owners'.

vectors.name: outcome_of_one_signer_with_another_amount
vectors.why: The terms have to be what the owner signed.

vectors.name: outcome_of_one_signer_with_no_confirm
vectors.why: The approval has to be tied to the step that carried it.

vectors.name: outcome_of_both_signers_labelled_as_one
vectors.why: A type two owners sign needs both, so one signature proves nothing.

vectors.name: outcome_of_a_type_nobody_signs
vectors.why: T's agent key said this, and the assurance says that's all.

vectors.name: outcome_of_nobody_labelled_as_an_owner
vectors.why: An agent's word can't pose as an owner's.

vectors.name: outcome_of_nobody_with_another_result
vectors.why: The result has to be what T's agent signed.

vectors.name: outcome_of_a_type_owners_sign_labelled_as_an_agents
vectors.why: An agent can't finish a type that needs its owner, in a bundle or a chain.

vectors.name: outcome_of_a_type_this_reader_doesnt_have
vectors.why: With no schema, a reader can't tell who has to stand behind it.

vectors.name: outcome_whose_confirm_another_key_signed
vectors.why: R's agent key has to have signed that confirm.

vectors.name: outcome_pairing_the_requester_with_another_owner
vectors.why: The agent and owner both have to have said it, so the bundle can't name someone else.

vectors.name: outcome_where_the_requester_signed_a_no
vectors.why: An owner's signed no isn't agreement.

vectors.name: outcome_where_the_requester_signed_a_cancel
vectors.why: A yes to cancelling isn't a yes to confirming.

vectors.name: outcome_where_the_requester_signed_another_request
vectors.why: A yes to one request doesn't prove another.

vectors.name: outcome_where_the_requester_signed_for_another_owner
vectors.why: The owner field must be the signer's.

vectors.name: outcome_where_the_requester_signed_for_another_agent
vectors.why: An approval covers one agent.

vectors.name: outcome_pairing_the_recipient_with_another_owner
vectors.why: The agent and owner both have to have said it, so the bundle can't name someone else.

vectors.name: outcome_where_the_recipient_signed_a_no
vectors.why: An owner's signed no isn't agreement.

vectors.name: outcome_where_the_recipient_signed_a_cancel
vectors.why: A yes to cancelling isn't a yes to confirming.

vectors.name: outcome_where_the_recipient_signed_another_request
vectors.why: A yes to one request doesn't prove another.

vectors.name: outcome_where_the_recipient_signed_for_another_owner
vectors.why: The owner field must be the signer's.

vectors.name: outcome_where_the_recipient_signed_for_another_agent
vectors.why: An approval covers one agent.
